DEATH NOTE / NOTE OF VERIFICATION OF DEATH Larkspur Hospice House, 2 Dunmore Lane, Pittsfield, Massachusetts Patient: Tadeusz Wojciechowski Hospice ID: LHH-88-0172 MRN: 0093-6615 DOB: 09/03/1997 (dd/mm - see below) Admitted to hospice: 04/10/2088 Date of death: 26/10/2088
Dictated by Dr. Rhys Penmarrow (locum, formerly of Cardiff) - dictated but not read.
I was called to see this gentlemen at about 03:50 on the morning of the 26th by the night nurse, Colleen Bright, who had found him without respiratory effort at 03:40. Mr Wojciechowski was a 91 year old man with a long history of ischaemic heart disease with previous coronary artery bypass grafting, type two diabetes with diabetic kidney disease, and metastatic prostate carcinoma, first diagnosed in March 2086 and treated with androgen deprivation and one cycle of docetaxel in March of that year. He had been admitted to this hospice on the fourth of October with pain and declining function. He has been seen daily by our team since then and had become progressively drowsier over the last 72 hours, with no oral intake for the last 48.
On examination he was lying peacefully in bed in Room 6 (Hawthorn). There was no response to voice or pain, pupils fixed and dilated, no carotid pulse, no heart sounds over a full minute of auscultation, no breath sounds. Death was verified at 03:58 on 26/10/88. He was not for resuscitation, the DNAR having been signed by him on admission. The coroner/medical examiner does not need to be informed as death was expected and from natural causes.
Next of kin: his daughter Halina Wojciechowska-Brennan was telephoned at +353 1 555 0143 in Dublin, Ireland at 04:20 (local time 09:20) and she asked that her brother Peter in Toronto, +1 416 555 0129, be told as well, which Nurse Bright did. Mrs Adaeze Okonjo, the neighbor who has the key to 14 Whitcombe Road, was informed this morning. They are planning for a requiem mass at the Church of Saint Stanislaus and burial beside his wife Zofia. Funeral director: Kowal and Daughters, Pittsfield.
